purchasing_v_choose_supplier: Choose the supplier, or add a new one
purchasing_v_choose_delivery: Choose where it should be delivered
purchasing_v_phone_format: Enter a phone number, e.g. 0911 234 567 or +251 11 551 8990
purchasing_v_email: Enter a valid email, or leave it empty
purchasing_v_department: Say who is asking: the department, ward or site
purchasing_v_choose_store: Choose the store it comes from
purchasing_po_add_line_first: Add at least one line before ordering.
purchasing_po_approval_reason: it is worth {value}, over the {limit} limit
purchasing_po_mark_ordered_first: Mark the order as ordered before receiving against it.
purchasing_po_receipt_pending: Draft receipt #{id} is already receiving this order; post or cancel it first.
purchasing_po_all_arrived: Everything on this order has arrived.
purchasing_reorder_tick_one: Tick at least one item and give it a quantity.
purchasing_reorder_choose_delivery: Choose where the orders should be delivered.
purchasing_reorder_item_gone: One of the items is no longer available; reload the page.
purchasing_item_no_supplier: {item} has no main supplier. Set one on the item first.
purchasing_v_item_from_list: Choose an item from the list.
purchasing_v_no_unit_conversion: {item} has no conversion for this unit. Add it on the item's page first.
purchasing_req_add_line_first: Add at least one line before submitting.
purchasing_req_not_submitted: It has not been submitted yet.
purchasing_req_own: You submitted this, so someone else has to approve it.
purchasing_req_reject_reason: Say why it is rejected, so the department knows.
purchasing_req_approve_range: Approve between 0 and {quantity} {unit} of {item}; more needs a new requisition.
purchasing_req_nothing_approved: Nothing was approved. Reject it instead, saying why.
purchasing_req_only_approved: Only an approved requisition is issued.
purchasing_req_issue_pending: Issue #{id} is already filling this; post or cancel it first.
purchasing_appr_own: You asked for this, so someone else has to approve it.
purchasing_appr_reject_reason: Say why it is rejected, so the person who asked can put it right.
purchasing_appr_done_order: Approved; order {number} can go to the supplier
purchasing_appr_only_requester: Only the person who asked can withdraw it.
purchasing_approval_needed: This needs a second person's approval: {reason}.
purchasing_v_supplier_from_list: Choose a supplier from the list.
purchasing_v_location_from_list: Choose a location from the list.
purchasing_po_created: Draft order created — add the lines
purchasing_orders_intro: What was ordered from whom, and what has arrived. Deliveries are received as goods receipts against the order.
purchasing_po_lines_locked: This order has been sent and its lines can no longer change.
purchasing_po_only_draft_changes: Only a draft order can change.
purchasing_po_sent_for_approval: Sent for approval: {reason}. It is ordered once someone else approves it.
purchasing_po_receipt_drafted: Receipt drafted from the order — correct the quantities to what arrived, then post
purchasing_po_email_only_placed: Only an order that has been placed can be emailed.
purchasing_po_supplier_no_email: {supplier} has no email address. Add one on the supplier's page.
purchasing_mail_intro: {org} would like to order the following, delivered to {place}.
purchasing_mail_quote_number: Please quote the order number on your delivery note and invoice.
purchasing_mail_failed: The email could not be sent. Try again, or print the order.
purchasing_po_only_open_close: Only an open order can be closed.
purchasing_po_closed: Order closed; what is still due is no longer expected
purchasing_po_part_arrived: Part of this order has arrived; close it instead.
purchasing_po_receipt_open: A receipt is open against this order; cancel it first.
purchasing_place_order_desc: It gets its number and the lines are fixed from here on. You can then print it or email it to {supplier}.
purchasing_sms_order_preview: The order number, the items and quantities, where to deliver and by when.
purchasing_supplier_no_email_short: The supplier has no email address
purchasing_close_order_desc: What was delivered stands. Anything still due is no longer expected and stops counting as "on order".
purchasing_print_quote_number: Please quote this order number on your delivery note and invoice.
purchasing_reorder_created_one: 1 draft order created — check the prices, then mark them as ordered
purchasing_reorder_created_many: {n} draft orders created — check the prices, then mark them as ordered
purchasing_reorder_intro: Items whose free stock (on hand, less what is held for proformas and requisitions) is at or below their minimum, and items that — at the rate they were used over the last 90 days — will run out before a delivery ordered today could arrive. The suggestion fills up to the maximum (twice the minimum when there is none), or enough for the supplier's lead time and a month after, less what is on order. Orders are created as drafts you can still change.
purchasing_reorder_nothing_here: Nothing needs reordering here. Set minimum and maximum levels on an item's page (per location), or a reorder level, to plan by them.
purchasing_reorder_nothing: Nothing needs reordering. Set minimum and maximum levels on an item's page (per location), or a reorder level, to plan by them.
purchasing_reorder_no_supplier_hint: — set one on the item to order it from here
purchasing_lead_assumed: The supplier has no lead time; a week is assumed
purchasing_suppliers_intro: Who your stock comes from. Every delivery names one, and every movement of stock keeps it.
purchasing_missing_phone_one: 1 supplier was carried over from before suppliers were tracked and has no phone number yet. Open it and add it.
purchasing_missing_phone_many: {n} suppliers were carried over from before suppliers were tracked and have no phone number yet. Open each one and add it.
purchasing_supplier_name_exists: A supplier with this name already exists.
purchasing_supplier_name_taken: Another supplier already has this name.
purchasing_status_inactive_hint: Inactive — hidden from the pickers, history kept
purchasing_items_main_supplier: Items with this supplier as their main supplier.
purchasing_deliveries_desc: At the price paid, VAT included; returns to them count against.
purchasing_f_lead_desc: How long they usually take from order to delivery. Reorder planning orders early enough to cover it; a week is assumed when empty.
purchasing_f_vat_no: Not VAT-registered — no VAT on their invoices
purchasing_selected_when_saved: It is selected as soon as it is saved.
purchasing_banner_waiting: Waiting for approval: {reason} ({value}). Asked by {who}. Someone else with the right to approve decides it on the
purchasing_banner_rejected: Rejected by {who}{note} Put it right and send it again.
purchasing_v_store_from_list: Choose a store from the list.
purchasing_req_drafted: Requisition drafted — add what is needed, then submit it
purchasing_requisitions_intro: What departments ask the store for. Asked, approved by someone else, then issued from the store.
purchasing_f_department_ph: Ward, kitchen, site or project asking
purchasing_req_lines_locked: This requisition has been submitted and its lines can no longer change.
purchasing_req_submitted_as: Submitted as {number} — someone who may approve requisitions decides next
purchasing_req_approved_msg: Approved — the store can issue it
purchasing_req_issue_drafted: Issue drafted from the requisition — check it, then post
purchasing_req_waiting_own: Waiting for approval. You submitted it, so someone else who may approve requisitions has to decide.
purchasing_approve_hint: Lower a quantity to approve less; 0 refuses that line. Approving holds the stock at the store when the business reserves stock.
purchasing_note_reject_ph: Why it was cut or refused
purchasing_approvals_intro: Adjustments, write-offs, count differences and purchase orders over the limits set on the business profile wait here for a second person. Approving does it, in the approver's name; the person who asked cannot approve their own.
purchasing_worth_now_changed: Worth {value} now ({then} when asked — it has changed since).
purchasing_note_reject_required: Note (required to reject: say what to put right)
purchasing_you_asked: You asked for this, so someone else decides it.
